captions.detailed: An upright arcade cabinet featuring a black chassis, a glowing orange marquee, a slanted dark screen, and a control deck with a joystick and three colored buttons (red, yellow, and blue). Below the control deck on the lower front face, there is a metallic coin-return slot and a large dark service door with a small silver handle. The service door is articulated to swing open on a vertical side hinge, while the coin-return flap rotates on a horizontal top hinge.
captions.instruction: Generate an upright arcade cabinet with a glowing marquee, a slanted screen, and a protruding control deck complete with a joystick and colorful buttons. Include an articulated lower service door that swings on a vertical hinge and an articulated coin-return flap that rotates on a horizontal hinge.
captions.factory: Construct the main cabinet body using a series of boolean cuts on a base box to form the slanted monitor bay and control deck profile. Model the marquee, screen, and control panel using colored boxes, and add cylinders and spheres for the joystick and buttons. Create the service door and coin-return flap as separate articulated parts, positioning their joints with appropriate rotational axes and limits to simulate realistic cabinet access.
